title: TalentSort v2: skills-first screening assistant for branch and field sales hiring
accountable_executive: Meera Iyer, Chief Human Resources Officer

use_case.purpose: Order the screening queue and highlight matched job-related skills so that recruiters, who review every application, can work through high volumes faster and more consistently.
use_case.problem_statement: About 60,000 applications a year; 14 recruiters spend an estimated 70% of their time on first-pass CV reading; time-to-hire averages 38 days.
expected_benefits: Faster first-pass review through queue ordering and skills highlighting
use_case.alternatives_considered: More recruiters only (about three times the licence cost and still slow at peak); structured screening questions alone (adopted as one of five inputs).

system.ai_output: Queue order and highlighted job-related skills for each application; no pass/fail flag

input_features: Skills assessment score (work sample: mock customer call and loan-eligibility case exercise)
Relevant certification (NISM / IRDAI where the role requires it)
Relevant sales experience (minimum threshold only, not scored above it)
Structured screening questions (field-work availability; two-wheeler licence for collections)
Language proficiency required for the branch, tested in the assessment
data.training_data: Work-sample assessment results of 9,400 candidates assessed 2024-2026, scored by trained assessors against a published rubric. No past hiring decisions used.
data.accuracy_controls: Candidates see and can correct the parsed profile before it is ranked; parser tested on 2,000 real CVs including regional-language formats (98.4% field accuracy).

source_documents: Referenced but summarised only: Samata Audit LLP report, job analysis for six role families, vendor model documentation v2.1
assumptions: automation_level recorded as 'assistive_ranking': every application is reviewed by a recruiter and nothing is archived or rejected without a recruiter decision (s. 1). Workload of about 120 applications per recruiter per day is within the committee's 150 target.
transfer_destinations left empty because processing is India-hosted (s. 1).
claims_needing_evidence: Samata Audit LLP report is summarised, not attached. The committee should receive the full report, including method and intersections.
Deletion of the video module 'for our tenant' (s. 1) should be confirmed by a test of outputs and logs, not by vendor statement alone.
Job analysis and model documentation v2.1 are referenced but not attached.
